metadata.geographic_caveat: Jurisdiction labels reproduce incorporation/headquarters/primary-listing locations in mixed source records; they are not independent revenue exposures. Marshall Islands/Bermuda incorporation does not imply local operating demand. AerCap label refers to Ireland headquarters, not Netherlands incorporation.
coverage_caveats: This is investigated breadth, not a globally exhaustive cheap-stock screen.
Some non-US ordinary prices and ADR/currency/share bridges remain unavailable; those names were not ranked as bargains.
Rolling investor pages and older role sources are explicitly weaker evidence than dated annual/interim releases.
Only nine companies have detailed intrinsic models; screening multiples are triage, not intrinsic valuation.
